CREATE TABLE object_version_relationships (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	relationship_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	binding VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	source_object_version_id CHAR(32), 
	target_object_version_id CHAR(32), 
	first_object_version_id CHAR(32), 
	second_object_version_id CHAR(32), 
	position INTEGER, 
	evidence_role VARCHAR(16), 
	ownership_scope_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	contribution_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	provenance_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_relationship_endpoints CHECK ((direction = 'UNIDIRECTIONAL' AND source_object_version_id IS NOT NULL AND target_object_version_id IS NOT NULL AND first_object_version_id IS NULL AND second_object_version_id IS NULL) OR (direction = 'BIDIRECTIONAL' AND source_object_version_id IS NULL AND target_object_version_id IS NULL AND first_object_version_id IS NOT NULL AND second_object_version_id IS NOT NULL AND first_object_version_id <= second_object_version_id)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_relationship_type_binding CHECK ((binding = 'STRUCTURAL' AND direction = 'UNIDIRECTIONAL' AND relationship_type IN ('ATTACHMENT','CONCLUSION','PREMISE','TARGET','EVIDENCE','RESULT')) OR (binding = 'DECLARATION' AND ((direction = 'BIDIRECTIONAL' AND relationship_type = 'EQUIVALENT_TO') OR (direction = 'UNIDIRECTIONAL' AND relationship_type IN ('DEPENDS_ON','PROVES','ATTEMPTS','REFUTES','USES','IMPLIES'))))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_relationship_position CHECK ((relationship_type IN ('PREMISE','EVIDENCE') AND position IS NOT NULL AND position >= 0) OR (relationship_type NOT IN ('PREMISE','EVIDENCE') AND position IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_relationship_evidence_role CHECK ((relationship_type = 'EVIDENCE' AND evidence_role IS NOT NULL AND evidence_role IN ('INPUT','SUPPORTS','CONTRADICTS','OUTPUT')) OR (relationship_type <> 'EVIDENCE' AND evidence_role IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_relationship_provenance CHECK (provenance_kind IN ('HUMAN_DIRECT','AGENT_PROPOSAL','AGENT_DIRECT')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_object_version_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_object_version_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(first_object_version_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(second_object_version_id) REFERENCES object_revisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ownership_scope_id) REFERENCES research_scopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contribution_id) REFERENCES contribution_envelopes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_structural_position ON object_version_relationships (source_object_version_id, relationship_type, position) WHERE position IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_structural_relationship ON object_version_relationships (source_object_version_id, relationship_type, target_object_version_id) WHERE binding = 'STRUCTURAL'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_structural_single_target ON object_version_relationships (source_object_version_id, relationship_type) WHERE relationship_type IN ('CONCLUSION','TARGET','RESULT')
